node build/index.js &

wait 2>/dev/null
echo "Server started and SSE endpoint responded successfully"

cd /Users/rafaelss8/Projetos/Pessoal/mcp-http

# Start server in background
node build/index.js &
SERVER_PID=$!
sleep 2

# 1. Connect to SSE and get session ID
echo "=== Connecting to SSE ==="
curl -s -N "http://localhost:3001/sse" -o /tmp/sse_output.txt &
SSE_PID=$!
sleep 2

# Extract session ID from SSE event
SESSION_ID=$(grep -oP 'sessionId=\K[^"]+' /tmp/sse_output.txt || grep -o 'sessionId=[^ ]*' /tmp/sse_output.txt | cut -d= -f2)
echo "Session ID: $SESSION_ID"

# 2. Initialize the connection
echo ""
echo "=== Initializing ==="
curl -s -X POST "http://localhost:3001/message?sessionId=$SESSION_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "jsonrpc": "2.0",
    "id": 1,
    "method": "initialize",
    "params": {
      "protocolVersion": "2024-11-05",
      "capabilities": {},
      "clientInfo": {"name": "test-client", "version": "1.0.0"}
    }
  }'

echo ""

# 3. List tools
echo ""
echo "=== Listing Tools ==="
curl -s -X POST "http://localhost:3001/message?sessionId=$SESSION_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "jsonrpc": "2.0",
    "id": 2,
    "method": "tools/list",
    "params": {}
  }'

echo ""

# 4. Call scrape_url tool
echo ""
echo "=== Scraping https://example.com ==="
curl -s -X POST "http://localhost:3001/message?sessionId=$SESSION_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "jsonrpc": "2.0",
    "id": 3,
    "method": "tools/call",
    "params": {
      "name": "scrape_url",
      "arguments": {
        "url": "https://example.com",
        "max_length": 500
      }
    }
  }'

echo ""

# Cleanup
kill $SSE_PID 2>/dev/null
kill $SERVER_PID 2>/dev/null
wait 2>/dev/null
echo ""
echo "=== Done ==="

pkill -f "node build/index.js" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1
node build/index.js &
sleep 2
echo "Server PID: $!"
